title: Rafael and the Safehouse
author: Wren Thackeray
blurb: Orsen Joubert, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
